summary: One added Scaladoc sentence overstates the postcondition of clear() for already-enqueued references.

items.issue: The doc says "the reference is not enqueued," which can be read as a postcondition after clear(). The implementation only delegates to java.lang.ref.Reference.clear(); clearing does not enqueue the reference, but it also does not imply an already-enqueued reference becomes un-enqueued.
items.suggestion: Use wording matching the inherited contract, e.g. "Clears this reference so that it no longer refers to its referent. This does not enqueue the reference."
